<!-- pr-reviewer: 054d7dbe8dcd3b3793d51cdc7d892a1fe770146e -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change reads both review endpoints and all pages. It selects the latest dated marker from a collaborator. It accepts an abbreviated SHA. The warning names both SHAs and stays on stderr.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at c42eeba78b1078093bcc874f0a560d620e74ffe7:
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask`: 163 passed; none failed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test merge_review`: 6 passed; none failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The gate preview included unrelated upstream changes because the trial merge was not committed. I selected the xtask tests directly. The compiler wrapper was disabled for these local commands.

Requested before merge: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, geometry, or UI. No goldens moved. I did not run mutations. This is not a safety-tier change. The regression tests use Unix command stubs. Windows execution and live authenticated merge planning were not tested.

The body has `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #2388`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
